tags.definition: Stall is primarily driven by large sender-side gaps or pacing delays between frames/packets.
evidence_examples: WINDOW_SUMMARY.p95_send_gap_ms is much larger than other gaps
Frame shows long first_send_ms to last_send_ms duration

tags.definition: Stall coincides with unusually large encoded frames that take longer to send.
evidence_examples: FRAME_DIGEST.frame_size_bytes is significantly higher than neighboring frames

tags.definition: Stall is associated with increased network transit gaps or one-way delay.
evidence_examples: WINDOW_SUMMARY.p95_net_gap_ms is high relative to send/recv gaps

tags.definition: Receiver-side processing or scheduling gaps dominate the stall window.
Packet loss and repair activity (NACK/RTX/FEC) likely contribute to stall.
